title: The Most Dangerous Game: conflict and character
prompt: Answer each question in two or three complete sentences. Quote the text to support your answers.

items.prompt: Rainsford and Whitney disagree about whether animals feel fear. Explain each man's view and what the disagreement shows about Rainsford.
Whitney says the crew's nerves seemed "a bit jumpy." What can you infer about the island from the way the sailors behave? Quote one detail that supports your inference.
Rainsford calls Whitney's "mental chill" "Pure imagination." How could this attitude set Rainsford up for conflict later in the story? Use what he says in the opening to explain.
